A weathered medieval stone cottage hunches on a windswept hillside at last light, its walls built from rough, mossy fieldstone streaked with damp and grime, crowned by a sagging shingle roof blackened with rot and lichen. A single narrow window bleeds dim, smoky orange firelight from within, its warped shutters hanging crooked on rusted hinges. A muddy dirt path cuts past the cottage through coarse, trampled grass and dead weeds, bordered by a broken wooden gate of split, blackened timber bound with frayed rope. The last embers of sun sink behind the cottage, casting the facing walls into deep cold shadow while a thin bruised glow clings to the horizon. The sky looms heavy and overcast, muddy grey-blue streaked with dull ember tones, low mist curling along the ground.
Style: cinematic film still, desaturated earth-and-ash palette, heavy shadows, 35mm film grain. Mood: bleak, foreboding, folk-horror. Equirectangular 360° panorama, 2:1 aspect ratio.
Fill the green spaces according to the image. Outpaint as a seamless 360 equirectangular panorama (2:1). Keep the horizon level. Match left and right edges.

inputs.prompt: Remove the visible seam in the middle of the image. Remove the white bar. Keep the rest of the image exactly the same.

inputs.value: A futuristic sidearm with an angular design. A handcrafted jury-rigged futuristic laser pistol laid horizontally on a seamless pale grey studio backdrop, shot in profile from the side. The compact weapon has a short hand-milled steel barrel wrapped loosely in thin copper wire, a single slim coolant tube threaded through the wooden grip and glowing a faint electric blue, a small scavenged phone battery taped into the rear housing, and a scratched brass charging tab. Crafted from thin metal plates, rusty and patched with exposed wires. Even, soft studio lighting from a large overhead softbox, no harsh shadows, subtle falloff toward the edges of the frame. Shot on an 85mm lens, razor sharp across the full length of the weapon, shallow depth of field falling off behind it. Neutral grey backdrop, product photography clarity. Use the drawing as rough layout.

Medium shot of the protagonist from the reference image in profile beside a dark bay horse in front of a modest timber-and-stone cottage at last light. The person on the left, the horse's neck and shoulder filling the right. Deep charcoal hooded cloak, hood down; dark leather cuirass. Left hand resting on the horse's withers, right hand resting on the horse's long black mane with his bare fingers, strands of hair falling between them mid-stroke. A shuttered cottage window glows warm orange blurred behind. Warm golden dusk key light from the left. Shallow depth of field. Cinematic medieval dark fantasy. Shot on 50mm f/2.8.

Static medium shot, camera does not move. The cloaked rider draws his bare fingers slowly down through the horse's long black mane in one steady, rhythmic stroke. He lifts his hand and begins a second stroke in the same calm rhythm. The horse stands relaxed. The background trees and stone cottage remain perfectly still, no wind. Audio: the soft whisper of fingers through coarse horsehair, the horse's slow steady breathing, low ambient forest tone from the treeline — no music, no wind in the leaves.
